title: Dataset Block
description: Top-level metadata record for a named dataset unit in the GAD training tower. One block = one promotable dataset (train, eval, retain, or preference). Consumed by evolution_dataset_manifest to compose training runs.

layer.description: Tower layer this dataset targets. Maps to training phase in the fine-tuning recipe.

source.description: Primary production channel. 'gad_trace' = curated from .planning/.gad-log; 'opus_teacher' = Opus-generated SFT pairs; 'distilled' = smaller model distilling Opus/GPT-5-class output.

task_shape.description: Short slug describing the task type this dataset trains. Examples: 'planning', 'tool_call', 'preference_pair', 'hard_failure_correction'.

row_count.description: Number of training examples currently in the dataset.

token_count.description: Estimated total token count across all rows (prompt + completion). Optional until measured.

license_class.description: 'owned' = fully GAD-generated or operator-authored; 'open' = permissive-licensed public data; 'restricted' = open but non-commercial; 'customer_private' = tenant-scoped, never shared.

quality_gate.description: Human-readable pass criterion that must hold before promotion. Example: 'schema_valid >= 0.99 AND human_spot_check >= 50 rows'.

evals.description: Eval IDs (from the eval registry) that must pass before this dataset is promoted. Blocking.

promotion_status.description: 'candidate' = under construction; 'promoted' = cleared all gates, in active recipe; 'deprecated' = superseded; 'frozen' = locked for eval reproducibility.

parent_dataset_id.description: dataset_id of the dataset this was derived from. Null for ground-truth originals.

producer_agent_id.description: Agent ID (from gad agent registry) that produced or curated this dataset.

producer_runtime.description: Runtime that ran the producing agent.
